concept.title: Code and file paths
concept.shortdesc: Code blocks keep monospace styling with horizontal scrolling; inline code and file paths stay legible in running text.

conbody.p: Long lines scroll inside the block rather than overflowing the page:

Inline forms: a command such as dita transtypes, a path such as out/site/index.html, and an attribute value such as chunk="to-content". Syntax highlighting is on the roadmap; blocks stay plain and dependable until then.
